strengths: Detection train/eval/export loop is real: YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images at 83% mAP@50 exported to ONNX/TFLite (Tusk); YOLO11n mAP50~0.85 on ~5,000 auto-generated frames (CARLA)
Latency work with measured results: TensorRT YOLO 56.7 to 10.9 ms (5.2x, 17.6 to 92 FPS) in COFFIN, plus custom CUDA kernels for VGG16 (49.2 vs 73.3 ms)
Edge deployment on Jetson as a systemd service with auto-restart and non-root isolation, which covers the on-device nice-to-have
Audio modeling depth beyond API calls: Whisper-style ASR from scratch (80-ch mel encoder, causal Transformer decoder, 15% WER) and faster-whisper STT in a live pipeline
Evaluation discipline across projects: mAP, IoU, Dice, WER, perplexity, accuracy-vs-latency trade-offs
real_gaps: No production ML at scale: no multi-tenant serving, load, fleet or SLA ownership. Everything is capstone, research or internship scope
No MLOps: no model registry, CI/CD for models, drift or monitoring, A/B or shadow deployment
No inheriting or reverse-engineering someone else's model codebase, and no vendor knowledge transfer
No audio event or sound detection (gunshot, glass break, alarm) and no fused audio+video detector. Audio work is speech recognition only
No video-stream detection: no RTSP/streaming ingest, tracking across frames, temporal models or multi-camera deployment
No security or public-space detection domain; no precision/recall work on a false-alarm-sensitive operational system
overstated_by_keywords: Multimodal counted Adjacent via SmolVLA, but SmolVLA is not in master_profile.json. The profile's real multimodal work is an STT + LLM + YOLO pipeline with each model separate, not a fused audio+video detector
Model serving counted Adjacent via TensorRT/Flask. That is single-device edge inference behind a Flask-SocketIO server, not a streaming inference backend
Training pipeline and inference counted Have, but at single-GPU, small-dataset scale
understated_by_keywords: From-scratch mel-spectrogram front end and Transformer decoder is genuine audio-DL depth the keyword pass only credited as ASR
BARC image pipeline (wavelet denoising, PSNR 86, depth estimation) shows classical signal processing applied to imaging, relevant to robust video and audio front ends
Auto-generated labeled data with occlusion filtering (CARLA) shows data-curation thinking for detection quality
screening_gaps: No production ML ownership at scale: the JD centers on owning a live detection engine, and nothing in the profile is deployed to real users
No audio or video detection model in production: ASR and object detection exist separately, but no fused audio/video event detection
No MLOps or monitoring experience, and no history of taking over a third-party model codebase, which is the stated core of the job
reasoning: Roughly a third to a half of the role is backed: detection training, latency optimization and edge deployment are concrete, with measured results. The core of the job, owning a production audio/video detection engine inherited from a vendor and improving it over time, has no direct evidence. Seniority is noted separately by the keyword read, but even on skills alone the production, MLOps and audio-event gaps are what a screener would reject on.
